objective: Measure exact normalized environment-state equivalence across two independent fresh-container executions of each unchanged Dev-5 environment plan.

runner_contract.source: For each repetition, create a new local no-hardlinks detached checkout from the retained Git object database at the exact inherited revision; never fetch or read dirty worktree files.
runner_contract.cleanliness_gate: Require exact HEAD and tree identity plus an empty git status independently before each bootstrap.
runner_contract.container_git_gate: Add only /data/project to Git safe.directory inside each temporary container.
runner_contract.mount: Each repetition receives distinct source and control directories plus the EnvSolve policy tree read-only; no writable volume is shared between repetitions.
runner_contract.external_fixture: Create only the preregistered collision-checked build_output directory in each separate temporary checkout.
runner_contract.bootstrap: Source the exact inherited frozen bootstrap in one persistent shell for each repetition.
runner_contract.network_transition: Allow network only during bootstrap; disconnect every Docker network before snapshot collection in each repetition.
runner_contract.snapshot_collection: Collect Python runtime, full marker environment, the complete canonical-name/raw-version installed-distribution multiset, and content-addressed project distribution metadata/provenance.
runner_contract.snapshot_hash: Canonical JSON with sorted object keys and normalized ordering; retain duplicate distribution observations; independently recompute the declared SHA-256 in the pair runner.
runner_contract.comparison: Require identical frozen identities and exact snapshot hashes; emit structured component multiset deltas when state differs.
runner_contract.temporary_storage: Use distinct host-platform temporary directories unless an explicit bind-mount-safe root is supplied.
runner_contract.cleanup: Always remove each container and temporary checkout after its raw replay artifact is written.

paired_replay_contract.role: Both executions are required experimental repetitions, not conditional retries.
paired_replay_contract.ordering: Execute replay A then replay B for each target; never skip B because A succeeded or failed.
paired_replay_contract.independence: Require distinct container IDs, detached checkouts, control directories, and writable layers with zero shared writable volumes.

decision_contract.v6_pass: Both complete, independently validated snapshots have identical SHA-256 values and no component delta.
decision_contract.v6_fail: Both snapshots are valid under the same frozen identity but at least one normalized state component differs.
decision_contract.v6_unknown: Either bootstrap or snapshot is missing, collection fails, a hash/source/network/identity check is invalid, a container ID is reused, or the replay identities differ.
decision_contract.single_snapshot: A single snapshot is always insufficient and cannot pass V6.

expected_causal_checks.online_resolution: Any package-version drift caused by unpinned online bootstrap resolution must appear as an installed-distributions delta, not be normalized away.
expected_causal_checks.project_state: Project metadata or provenance drift must appear as a project-distributions delta even if imports still pass.
expected_causal_checks.ephemera: Container IDs and timings must differ without causing state failure.
expected_causal_checks.infrastructure: A pre-snapshot network failure leaves the affected case unknown; it is not state equivalence evidence.
expected_causal_checks.official_outcomes: No official verifier runs and no official score changes.
